recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, overexposed portrait of a woman centered against a pure white background, featuring a mix of elegant serif typography and large-scale, fluid script lettering that overlaps the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered with high-key lighting blending into the white background
Large script lettering acting as a mid-ground layer between subject and viewer
Small, wide-tracked serif text providing a structured anchor to the fluid script
Warm skin tones contrasting with cool blue and dark brown typographic elements
coreInvariants: Overexposed highlights on the subject's clothing and skin
Three-tier typographic hierarchy: small top, large middle script, medium bottom serif

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, waist-up, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, blue script lettering in the center-left serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top small text, drop to the large script, follow the script's curve to the subject's face, and settle on the bottom serif text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space on the left and right margins, created by the high-key lighting blowing out the edges of the subject.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Steel Blue (Script lettering) and Dark Umber (Serif text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low-to-medium saturation; the background is max value, while the text provides the only deep values.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Humanist script and Extended Roman Serif
letterConstructionRules: Script: Thin, consistent monolinear stroke with large loops and high ascenders
Serif: Wide horizontal proportions, sharp triangular serifs, and high stroke contrast
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'C' features an oversized, sweeping top curve
The serif 'D' and 'O' are significantly widened to create a stable base
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, vertical script and geometric, horizontal extended serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, small-serif aesthetic for the secondary text.
Captures the fluid, handwritten feel of the primary name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio portrait of a woman with warm skin tones and reddish hair, wearing a white t-shirt and light blue jeans. The lighting should be so bright that the edges of her shirt and the background blend into a seamless pure white #FFFFFF. The subject should be centered and looking slightly down at the camera with a soft smile.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, thin, steel-blue script name across the center-left, overlapping the subject's torso. Below it, add a second name in a dark umber, wide-tracked, all-caps extended serif font. At the top left, add a short phrase in the same dark umber serif font but at a much smaller scale.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white without any gray shadows?
Does the script text overlap the subject?
Is the serif text significantly wider than standard proportions?
Is the lighting on the subject's face warm and glowing?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the serif text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Seamless transition between subject and white background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the white shirt doesn't have visible outlines against the background.
Ensure the script font is thin and elegant, not chunky.
Verify the all-caps text has generous letter spacing.
Confirm the color palette remains limited to white, peach, blue, and brown.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key portrait + Overlapping monoline script + Wide-tracked extended serif footer = 90s Pop Editorial Style.
